identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.07c][117.c] Prove Observatory security, privacy, and adversarial behavior

values.summary: Bootstrap and review #281 as a bounded Observatory security/privacy/adversarial proof issue; after terminal dependency validation, bind a FastWork worktree, add deterministic proof and narrow UI fixes if needed, then exact-review, publish, observe CI, and finish.

steps.action: Create the #281 six-card packet and issue-owned preparation validator that proves live issue identity, dependency ancestry, and security/privacy scope boundaries.
Obtain a fresh no-context design review and approve only if #281 remains a security/privacy/adversarial proof issue with truthful #279/#280/#282 deferrals.
Bind in the FastWork issue worktree and implement the smallest deterministic security/privacy/adversarial proof plus any narrowly required Observatory fixes.
Run focused proof, strict relevant checks, diff hygiene, fresh exact-head review, typed publication, required CI, and typed finish.

invariants: Every browser-visible security/privacy state is representational and tied to Runtime-owned evidence or deterministic fixture input
Security/privacy proof must not depend on hidden network, provider, cloud, credential, paid runner, raw provider payload, private cognition, or Unity state
Browser changes cannot grant policy authority, synthesize delivery, mask refusal, hide stale authorization, or hold private signing material
#279/#280/#282 and parent coordination records stay out of #281 source/lifecycle ownership
risks: A proof-only issue could uncover defects that belong to Runtime or sibling proof owners rather than #281
Fixture-based adversarial proof could overclaim live integrated behavior unless exact candidate revision and non-live boundary are recorded
Redaction checks could become superficial if they only search for sample strings instead of enforcing denylisted evidence classes
Origin/transport proof could overclaim TLS deployment unless it stays limited to allowed metadata and fail-closed behavior in local/public-safe proof
stop_conditions: Any required dependency merge is missing, noncanonical, or nonancestral
Design review finds #281 claims Runtime authority or #279/#280/#282 scope
A required proof needs credentials, cloud/public deployment, Unity live host, raw provider payloads, private cognition, or paid runner
Implementation would require Runtime contract changes or sibling issue worktree mutation
Focused proof, review, CI, publication, or terminal finish fails
